archetypes.name: pin-token-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The plan specifies exact backtick-quoted grep token strings for structure-test pins; any whitespace or punctuation drift between those tokens and the SKILL.md prose they assert will cause silent false-passes or false-failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each proposed grep-Fq pin in `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh` (both positive and negative), locate the exact SKILL.md phrase the plan intends to produce and verify that the token string in the plan matches that phrase character-for-character, including backtick placement, spacing, and trailing punctuation. Check whether the negative-pin token (`default \`LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL=bash\` runs the bash contract`) will false-trigger on any preserved bash-opt-in documentation the plan intentionally leaves in place. Check whether any pin token is so generic it would match unintended lines outside the selector block (e.g., a bash-only gate sentence that also contains the token). Verify that the `--state-file` pin token is derivable from the exact argv line the plan specifies, not a paraphrase of it. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scope-gap
archetypes.rationale: The plan enumerates 10 files but defers stale-reference remediation to a testing-phase rg sweep; if that sweep finds files outside the listed scope the PR will ship with inconsistent documentation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate all files in the repository (outside `larch-logs/`) that reference `LARCH_SHIP_PR_IMPL`, `default bash`, `ship-pr.sh` as a primary/default driver, `during the soak`, `dev/CI-only until Phase 7`, `not wired into the live`, or `mechanically delegated to.*ship-pr` — then compare that set against the 10-file scope list in the plan. Identify any files the plan omits that will become inconsistent with the python-default flip and are not covered by the plan's testing-strategy sweep commitment. Also check whether `skills/implement/references/` contains files other than `stall-recovery.md` that reference `ship-pr.sh` recovery or the bash-primary framing and are therefore out-of-scope gaps. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
